scope: Delta only: authenticated media byte ranges, shutdown admission, cancellation publication, preview media lifecycle

checksPerformed.check: Read complete frozen delta and relevant current server/adapter source
checksPerformed.result: Range processing remains behind existing exact Host/Origin validation and API authentication; verified asset lookup and completed-job checks precede media response.

Anchored digits-only single range grammar; safe integers required; outside/reversed/multiple ranges rejected; end clamped to actual buffer; response headers derive only from validated numbers and fixed MIME values.
Actual HTTP 206 returned correct 16 bytes and Content-Range; outside and multipart requests returned 416; existing auth/origin/restart negatives still pass.

checksPerformed.command: rtk node --test --test-name-pattern="queue closure|cancellation during artifact" tests/core.test.ts
checksPerformed.result: Publication cancellation leaves no completed output; queue shutdown rejects delayed and subsequent submissions.
New media instances receive same API asset URLs generated from validated project/asset UUIDs. No new raw DOM, eval, command or remote URL sink.

verdict: pass: no reproducible in-scope security regression in delta
limitations: Existing whole-file buffering and native codec isolation remain documented preview release gates; delta introduces no new isolation claim.
